name: Pipedrive
one_liner: Pipedrive is a sales CRM and pipeline-management platform with a broad REST API (OAuth2 or per-user API token) and a vendor-official MCP server, accessible via a no-credit-card 14-day trial before requiring a paid plan.
auto_notes: pass1/pass2 disagree on access (self_serve_free vs self_serve_trial)

evidence.quote: An official, reliable and fully supported connection built and maintained by Pipedrive.
Pipedrive MCP is available on all Pipedrive plans. Usage is based on token limits included in your plan and additional tokens can be purchased if needed.
Authorization via OAuth 2.0 is a well-known and stable way to get fine-grained access to an API.
The API token must be provided in the `x-api-token` header for all requests.
an API token is tied to a specific user and company, giving access to all user's data
Unauthenticated probe -> HTTP 401; WWW-Authenticate: None; body: {"success":false,"error":"unauthorized access","errorCode":401,"error_info":"Please check developers.pipedrive.com"}

notes: Pipedrive has no permanent free tier; API access comes via a 14-day self-serve free trial (no credit card) that converts to a paid plan (from $12.50/user/mo). Both API token (x-api-token header, aka api_key) and OAuth2 (for Marketplace apps) are documented; HTTP Basic Auth appears only as the client_id/client_secret step of the OAuth2 code exchange, not a standalone API auth method, so it was not listed separately. Pipedrive shipped an official, vendor-hosted MCP server (mcp.pipedrive.ai) in 2026, bundled into all plans via OAuth connect — no separate approval needed beyond having a Pipedrive account. api_breadth is estimated "large" based on the breadth of REST resources (Deals, Persons, Organizations, Activities, Leads, Products, Pipelines, Users, Files, Webhooks, etc.) and third-party tool wrappers reporting 400+ operations; I could not load the official endpoint index (404/timeout) to verify an exact count, so this figure carries lower confidence than the auth/access findings.
